topic: Day 46 — carousel — Trust can't be demanded and extended by the same relationship at once

slides.text: Can't demand [trust] and extend it too.
One side extends, one side receives, resentment builds.
A persistent imbalance erodes things, even quietly.
Reciprocity has to roughly match over time.

caption:
You can extend trust or you can demand it, but not both in the same relationship without one side quietly resenting it.

Follow for one of these a day.
